{{Youmay|the mining method|the [[Lava skimmer/Legends|mining tool]], or the [[Darien lava-skimmer]]}}
'''Lava skimming''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] method that was practiced on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], including [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], [[Eos]], [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]], and [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
